capability.suite.description: frozen capability suite (authored items, core + node scope)

lore.chunks.description: the lore corpus cut into ~500-char chunks

lore.corpus.description: canon corpus (persona/mythos) rebuilt from the repo's shared docs

lore.qa.description: windowed QA pairs generated over the lore chunks

lore.qa.grounded.description: judge-verified windowed QA: entailed, diegetic, confidence >= 0.6

r1.eval.description: the frozen round-1 eval split (10% per source, seed 42)

r1.train.description: round-1 GRPO rows: windowed + identity QA, frozen 10% eval

r1.train.grounded.description: r1 train rows with the target chunk window injected as context

r2.warmup.description: round-2 SFT rows: think -> lore_search call -> result -> answer

sft.mix.description: SFT set: retrieval demos (r2.warmup) + per-tool demos, weighted

tools.trajectories.description: per-tool trajectories: teacher -> real MCP call -> real result -> answer, kept only if the gate's own checks pass
